overview.metaDescription: Learn about AGVS and our core material-handling businesses.

hero.titleHtml:
We automate the flow of materials,
and expand what production can do.
hero.description: AGVS is a logistics automation specialist that develops and supplies automated guided vehicles (AGVs) and control systems tailored to diverse production and logistics environments.
hero.visualAria: Conceptual diagram of an AGV logistics automation system

about.cardCopy: We connect AGVs, control systems, mechanical design, and operations software as one system.
about.titleHtml:
We turn customer needs into
automation that works on site.
about.p1: Since our founding, AGVS has developed and supplied AGVs and control systems to meet a wide range of customer requirements. Building on field experience and technical know-how, we continue to advance AGV control systems, mechanical design, and operator interface software.
about.p2: Beyond delivering individual machines, we design systems so vehicles, transfer equipment, and operations software work as one continuous flow. Guided by reliability, usability, scalability, and flexibility, we support efficient production and logistics operations.
about.cap1Copy: From mechanical design to control systems and operator interfaces, we build each layer to work together.
about.cap2Copy: We design practical systems around process, space, payloads, and operating conditions.
about.cap3Copy: We aim for architectures that can adapt to line changes and equipment expansion.

business.titleHtml:
From mobile equipment to control,
one continuous logistics flow.
business.lead: AGVS builds production and logistics automation systems around AGVs, autonomous forklifts, automated warehouses, automatic transfer, conveyors, and logistics/AGV management software.
business.note: We integrate machines, equipment, and software to design the entire material flow.
business.b1Desc: An unmanned transport system that automatically moves materials and parts on production and logistics floors.
business.b2Desc: A system that moves pallets and loads without an operator and automates inbound and outbound handling.
business.b3Desc: An AS/RS solution that improves storage utilization and inbound/outbound accuracy.
business.b4Desc: An automatic transfer solution that connects material flow between processes and equipment.
business.b5Desc: A tailored system for continuous, stable transfer of products, parts, and packaged goods.
business.b6Title: Logistics & AGV Management Software and Control
business.b6Desc: Operations software and control systems that centrally manage dispatching, routes, status, and work information.

values.titleHtml:
Four standards that define
system quality
values.lead: AGVS designs automation around reliability, usability, scalability, and flexibility so systems run stably on site and adapt to change.
values.v1Copy: We prioritize consistency and durability so systems can operate steadily on the production floor.
values.v2Copy: We design environments where operators can quickly understand system status and work efficiently.
values.v3Copy: We aim for structures that can expand functions and operating range as equipment, vehicles, and processes grow.
values.v4Copy: We configure systems flexibly so they can reflect each customer’s logistics conditions and operating scenarios.
